messages:
support-bot: FYI incoming escalation from Support — customer 'AcmePay' reports large spike in 5xx + timeouts against /v1/generate (hosted) starting ~2026-03-15T09:10Z. Attached sample request IDs and 500 responses. customer upset, asked for ETA.

miriam.sre: saw SLO alert too — /v1/generate 5xx rate crossed 3% threshold 09:12 UTC, SLO burn window 47m. dash: https://grafana.internal/redwood/slo#generate-5xx (posted by alert)

alex.sre: going to grab traces/logs. quick check — did we have a rollout around that time? @deploy-bot any canaries?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started 2026-03-15T08:58Z, service: inference-runtime, image: sha256:7f3a12c (kernel selection optimization). No full rollout yet.

ben.infra: querying logs for 09:05-09:20 UTC. Datadog query:
```
service:inference-runtime AND path:"/v1/generate" AND status:[500 TO 599]
| stats count() by status, error.message
| sort by count desc
```
Top errors: `runtime.kv_cache_evict_timeout` and `rpc: upstream stream reset`.

carla.prod: Support attached a sample curl that reproduces 500 for them; I ran it from our us-west-dev bastion and got a 504 (timeout) after ~30s. sample:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-70b","input":"<long prompt>"}'
```

alex.sre: interesting — logs show lots of long-context requests (30k tokens) hitting same nodes. runtime metrics show tokenization latency spike and worker queue depth saturated. I suspect KV cache thrash + large context causing compile/kernels path to block, leading to request timeouts and 5xx from internal worker aborts.

miriam.sre: traces are weird: a bunch of requests have no full traces — only ingress span then drop. sampling looks correct. probable tracing gap when worker panics/no flush. trace sample id: `trace: 0x9a4b...` shows ingress->allocator->(missing)->error. Could be worker crash before span flush.

ben.infra: checking node metrics: GPU mem spike and sudden OOM kill on pod inference-runtime-7f3a12c-2 at 09:11:23. Kube events show `OOMKilled` and pod restarted by liveness probe. Pod restarted repeatedly on that node.

carla.prod: correlates with canary image. Canary pods have the new kernel selection. Old pods (pre-canary) are fine. We should roll canary back to stop SLO burn and give time to debug.

alex.sre: Agreed. Mitigation plan:
- rollback canary (scale canary to 0 / deploy previous image)
- temporarily route traffic away from the affected node pool (taint + drain)
- update SLO incident page and message Support to pause escalation

miriam.sre: executing rollback now. kubectl set image deployment/inference-runtime inference-runtime=sha256:5c1b9d0 --namespace=prod-canary

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by miriam.sre at 2026-03-15T09:18Z. New image: sha256:5c1b9d0. Scaling canary down to 0 replicas.

ben.infra: draining node and cordon in progress: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-12` / `kubectl drain ... --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — will take ~2m for eviction.

carla.prod: after rollback+drain, 5xx rate trending down. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/slo#generate-5xx (chart shows drop at 09:22). Will keep monitoring.

miriam.sre: confirmed SLO burn stopped, customer contact updated — telling them we've mitigated and investigating root cause. Next steps: capture core dumps from canary, run load reproduction with long-context inputs against canary image in staging, and revert kernel change if reproduction matches.

alex.sre: notes for postmortem:
- short-term: rollback saved SLO, escalate to infra+runtime teams
- long-term: add canary circuit-breaker to limit long-contexts to small fraction, add preflight token-length rate-limiter, improve KV cache eviction telemetry

carla.prod: I'll update incident doc + ping support to confirm customer is unblocked. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Customer update sent at 2026-03-15T09:30Z: "We've applied a mitigation (rollback) and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for a fix."
